hook: Your petrol bill starts far from home.

storyboard.visual: Nozzle enters; molten fuel route ignites across the globe.
Camera travels with the fuel route past a tanker.
Route resolves at the city fuel marker.
Fuel stream slows; the city remains illuminated.

voiceover: Your petrol bill starts far from home. Crude moves through shipping and refining before India sees the effect. A market move travels. BhaavBrief.
caption: Crude is only the first link. Shipping, refining and domestic pricing determine how a global move eventually reaches a fuel bill. Educational data, not investment advice.
approval_note: Concept only. A current-event version needs a source-verified causal chain and compliance review.
